text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: rollout started: inference-api v2.14 -> prod canary=12% (strategy=blue-green, labels=canary=true)
jamie: 02:04 UTC — noticing repeated readiness failures and some crashloop restarts on canary pods.
ashley: paging oncall. can someone fetch the pod logs for the canary replicaset?
jamie: got one: `kubectl -n prod logs rs/inference-api-canary-7x2m -c inference --tail=200` shows repeated allocation spikes and then OOMKill. stack points at `dedupe_cache::allocate()` in init path.
tj: HPA metrics look noisy — replicas oscillating 2->9 in short window, looks like restarts causing CPU spike.
ashley: request immediate hold on traffic routing to canary. deploy-bot, hold?
deploy-bot: rollout paused (requested by @ashley) — canary traffic frozen at 12%.
jamie: reproduced locally with the release image + canary manifest.noticed `INFERENCE_DEDUP_ENABLED` defaulted to true in the baked image. this was intended to be behind a runtime flag but got baked.
elaine: CS reporting increased error rates for a handful of hosted customers. preparing notice.
support-bot: severity: S2 9raised error rate, not full outage.
ashley: mitigation options: A) toggle runtime flag B) scale canary RS to 0 C) rollback to previous revision. Which path is fastest?
jamie: there's no runtime toggle in the image; change is compiled in. fastest immediate is scale RS to 0 or rollback. scaling RS to 0 will stop churn quickly.
tj: executing scale now:
```sh
kubectl -n prod scale rs -l canary=true --replicas=0
# scaled
```
tj: canary replicaset scaled to 0. HPA stabilized ~50s later. stable RS no longer experiencing restarts.
jamie: grafana confirms 5xx rate returned to baseline within 2m of scaledown.
ashley: good. initiate a rollback for safety. tj, please run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=41` to ensure cluster running stable image.
tj: initiating rollback now.
deploy-bot: rollback started to revision 41 (initiated by @tj).
ashley: customer impact note: degraded service between 02:04-02:12 UTC for requests routed to canary; approx 2.7% error rate bump for impacted traffic. inform customers.
elaine: sending templated customer update to top affected accounts now.
sam: i'll take oncall in 25m and will follow up with postmortem + RCA. any outstanding tasks?
jamie: need to update release process: avoid baking feature flips into images without a runtime toggle. also add a readiness probe grace for memory allocations.
ashley: action items:
- jamie: revert dedupe change and add runtime toggle (ETA 4h)
- tj: add a manifest lint rule to block baked feature toggles (ETA 24h)
- sam: draft postmortem + customer impact memo (ETA 6h)
- elaine: follow-up to customers and open CS tickets (ETA 1h)
oncall-bot: oncall handoff scheduled: @ashley -> @sam at 02:30 UTC. handoff note: canary scaled down, rollback initiated, customers notified.
jamie: root cause hypothesis: release included config baked flip enabling `dedupe_cache` that triggers transient high memory during init; combined with aggressive readiness probe and HPA reacting to CPU bursts caused crashlooping and replica churn.
ashley: closing active mitigation thread; monitoring for resurge. if errors spike, @sam will reopen and escalate. :thumbsup:
sam: acknowledged. will spin off a follow-up channel for RCA and retros.
elaine: good work team, nice quick mitigation. :heart:
